system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The planning agent's inputs consist of four parts: user instruction Ins, the focus content F Ct in memory unit, the previous operation Ot−1, and the previous task progress T Pt−1.
system_prompt_style.note: Mobile-Agent-v2 code not in evidence. The paper describes per-role prompts filled with state. The sibling PC-Agent prompt.py uses conditional sections, which suggests possible dynamic composition.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Inputting a screenshot into this module will ultimately yield the text and icon information present on the screen, along with their respective coordinates.
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: the screen perception output (OCR/icon) is injected each step and the model navigates through GUI actions. Could also be coded mixed.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: The planning agent condenses lengthy, interleaved image-text history operations and screens summaries into a pure-text task progress

observation_format.evidence_quote: Inputting a screenshot into this module will ultimately yield the text and icon information present on the screen, along with their respective coordinates.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: we design an operation space and restricted the decision agent to selecting operations only from within this space.
tool_call_format.note: Closest value. Actions are free-text strings such as Tap (x, y) parsed from the output, not JSON. Mismatch flagged for Ambiguities.

tool_count.evidence_quote: Stop. If the decision agent thinks that all requirements have been fulfilled, it can use this operation to terminate the entire operation process.
tool_count.note: Counts the 6 operations: Open app, Tap, Swipe, Type, Home, Stop. The code is not in the evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Below is a detailed description of the operation space:
edit_primitive.note: GUI agent; there is no file-edit operation in the operation space.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Tap ( x, y). This operation is used to tap on the position with coordinates (x, y).

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the reflection agent observes the screens before and after the operation to determine if the operation meets expectations.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the planning agent observes the decision agent's operation Ot−1 from the last iteration and updates the task progress T Pt−1 to T Pt.
planning_granularity.note: Task progress is text that is re-read at each step. Could be argued as implicit.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The three agent roles work respectively in the progress, decision, and reflection stages, collaborating to alleviate the difficulty of navigating.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: After generating the task progress, the planning agent passes it to the decision agent.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: we design a memory unit to store the focus content related to the current task from history screens.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: The memory unit serves as a short-term memory module that is updated as the task progresses.
long_term_memory.note: The only memory described is short-term within a run.

self_verification.evidence_quote: we design the reflection agent to observe the screen state before and after a decision agent's operation to determine whether the current operation meets expectations.
self_verification.note: The reflection agent is a separate role, possibly the same model (GPT-4V).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If erroneous operation, the page will revert to the state before the operation.
retry_policy.note: Step-level correction only; no task-level retry is described.

rollback.evidence_quote: If erroneous operation, the page will revert to the state before the operation.
rollback.note: The page revert is GUI navigation, not a snapshot. Closest value: none.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: it can use this operation to terminate the entire operation process.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: We used Android Debug Bridge (ADB) as the tool for operating mobile devices.
execution_isolation.note: Closest value: actions run on a real device via ADB.

eval_hooks.note: The v3 AndroidWorld runner exists in the repo, but nothing is shown for v2.

target_domain.evidence_quote: we propose Mobile-Agent-v2, a multi-agent architecture for mobile device operation assistance.

open_source.evidence_quote: The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/X-PLUG/MobileAgent.
open_source.note: The LICENSE file is not in evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: we evaluate the performance of different MLLMs within the Mobile-Agent-v2 framework.
model_agnostic.note: GPT-4V, Gemini and Qwen-VL were tested.
